mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2C9, 2D6, 3A4) which may reduce turmeric's hepatic metabolism and increase curcuminoid levels, while turmeric may potentiate anticoagulant effects and inhibit further CYP450 activity.
action: Monitor for increased turmeric-related effects (GI upset, antiplatelet activity); consider adjusting doses or spacing administration; counsel on bleeding precautions if patient is on concurrent anticoagulants.
